purpose: Context KB for pain.008.001.08 CustomerDirectDebitInitiation auto-fixing. For each XML tag: datatype, mandatory, errors, possible_fixes.

iso_20022_rules.PmtMtd_fixed_DD: PmtInf/PmtMtd must be 'DD' (DirectDebit) for pain.008; no other payment method is valid for a customer direct debit initiation.
iso_20022_rules.NbOfTxs_count: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the total number of DrctDbtTxInf occurrences across all PmtInf blocks.
iso_20022_rules.CtrlSum_sum: When present, GrpHdr/CtrlSum (and PmtInf/CtrlSum) must equal the sum of the contained InstdAmt values.
iso_20022_rules.ReqdColltnDt_present: Each PmtInf must carry a ReqdColltnDt (Requested Collection Date); it is mandatory and date-only (ISODate).
iso_20022_rules.MndtRltdInf_pair: When MndtRltdInf is present, MndtId and DtOfSgntr are both required within it.
iso_20022_rules.Cdtr_identification: Each PmtInf must identify the Creditor (Cdtr/Nm), the Creditor account (CdtrAcct/Id/IBAN) and the Creditor agent (CdtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI).
iso_20022_rules.Dbtr_identification: Each DrctDbtTxInf must identify the Debtor (Dbtr/Nm), the Debtor account (DbtrAcct/Id/IBAN) and the Debtor agent (DbtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI).

cbpr_plus_formal_rules: AppHdr (BusinessApplicationHeaderV02) is mandatory for all CBPR+ exchanges and must precede the Document.
AppHdr/BizSvc is mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025 and must be 'swift.cbprplus.02' for pain.008.001.08.
AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'pain.008.001.08' and match the Document namespace identifier.
AppHdr/CreDt and GrpHdr/CreDtTm must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; the 'Z' suffix and milliseconds are forbidden.
FwdgAgt (GrpHdr/FwdgAgt) is mandatory under CBPR+ for pain.008 even though the base ISO 20022 schema marks it optional.
ReqdColltnDt must not be in the past relative to the message creation/processing date.
All text fields are restricted to the SWIFT FIN-X character set; Nm/Adr/RmtInf may use the extended Latin character set.
Agent identification (CdtrAgt, DbtrAgt) must use FinInstnId; when BICFI is present, Nm and PstlAdr are not used in the same block.
Account identification (CdtrAcct, DbtrAcct) should use IBAN where the account is held in an IBAN country.
GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the count of DrctDbtTxInf occurrences and CBPR+ favours single-transaction messages.

tags.description: Business Application Header V02. Mandatory for all CBPR+ messages and must wrap the pain.008 Document.

errors.description: AppHdr element is absent; CBPR+ mandates BusinessApplicationHeaderV02.
possible_fixes: Insert a complete <AppHdr> block before the <Document> element.
Ensure AppHdr contains Fr, To, BizMsgIdr, MsgDefIdr, BizSvc and CreDt.

tags.description: Sending MessagingEndpoint. Must contain a BIC8 or BIC11 (FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI) when exchanged on SWIFT.

errors.description: Fr element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <Fr><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{sender_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></Fr> inside AppHdr.
Harvest the BICFI from the forwarding/creditor agent if the sender BIC is not otherwise known.

errors.description: AppHdr/Fr contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters per ISO 9362.
Example valid BIC: DEUTDEFFXXX

tags.description: Receiving MessagingEndpoint. Must contain a BIC8 or BIC11 (FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI) on SWIFT.

errors.description: To element is absent from AppHdr.
possible_fixes: Insert <To><FIId><FinInstnId><BICFI>{receiver_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FIId></To> inside AppHdr.
Harvest the BICFI from the creditor agent (CdtrAgt) if the receiver BIC is not otherwise known.

errors.description: AppHdr/To contains an invalid or malformed BIC.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters per ISO 9362.

tags.description: Unique identifier of the Business Message. Must equal GrpHdr/MsgId.

possible_fixes: Copy the value of GrpHdr/MsgId and insert as <BizMsgIdr>{MsgId_value}</BizMsgIdr>.
If MsgId is also absent, generate a unique Max35Text value (e.g. MSG-20260601-001).
Read GrpHdr/MsgId and set BizMsgIdr to the same value.
If BizMsgIdr is authoritative, update GrpHdr/MsgId to match it instead. Never invent a new value.

tags.description: Message Definition Identifier. Must exactly match the Document namespace (pain.008.001.08).

possible_fixes: Insert <MsgDefIdr>pain.008.001.08</MsgDefIdr> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr does not match the Document xmlns namespace identifier.
possible_fixes: Read the xmlns attribute of the Document root (urn:iso:std:iso:20022:tech:xsd:pain.008.001.08) and set MsgDefIdr to 'pain.008.001.08'.
Ensure no trailing spaces or version mismatches.

tags.description: Business Service identifier. Mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025; must be 'swift.cbprplus.02' for pain.008.001.08.

errors.description: BizSvc is absent; it is mandatory under CBPR+ SR2025.
possible_fixes: Insert <BizSvc>swift.cbprplus.02</BizSvc> inside AppHdr.
Replace value with 'swift.cbprplus.02' as mandated for pain.008.001.08 under CBPR+.

tags.description: Creation date/time of the Business Message. Must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; the 'Z' suffix and milliseconds are forbidden under CBPR+.

possible_fixes: Insert <CreDt>{current datetime as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00}</CreDt> inside AppHdr.

errors.description: AppHdr/CreDt uses the 'Z' suffix which is forbidden under CBPR+.
AppHdr/CreDt has no timezone offset; CBPR+ requires an explicit +HH:MM offset.

tags.description: Unique message identifier assigned by the initiating party. Must equal AppHdr/BizMsgIdr. No leading/trailing spaces.

possible_fixes: Insert <MsgId>{unique identifier up to 35 chars}</MsgId> as first child of GrpHdr.
Use format MSG-YYYYMMDD-NNN (e.g. MSG-20260601-001) and copy the value to AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.
Truncate to a maximum of 35 characters preserving a meaningful, unique prefix.
Synchronize the truncated value to AppHdr/BizMsgIdr.

tags.description: Creation date and time of the message. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM; 'Z' suffix and milliseconds forbidden under CBPR+.

possible_fixes: Insert <CreDtTm>{current datetime as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00}</CreDtTm>.

errors.description: CreDtTm uses the 'Z' suffix; forbidden under CBPR+.
CreDtTm has no timezone offset; CBPR+ requires an explicit +HH:MM offset.

tags.description: Total number of individual transactions. Must equal the count of DrctDbtTxInf occurrences across all PmtInf blocks.

possible_fixes: Count all DrctDbtTxInf blocks and insert <NbOfTxs>{count}</NbOfTxs>.

errors.description: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs does not equal the actual number of DrctDbtTxInf blocks.
possible_fixes: Count all DrctDbtTxInf elements in every PmtInf and set NbOfTxs to that total.
Ensure PmtInf/NbOfTxs (when present) is consistent with the per-PmtInf transaction count.
Replace with a numeric integer string (max 15 digits). Example: '1'.

tags.description: Control sum. When present, must equal the sum of all DrctDbtTxInf/InstdAmt values across the message.

errors.description: GrpHdr/CtrlSum does not equal the sum of all InstdAmt values.
possible_fixes: Sum all InstdAmt values and set CtrlSum to the result.
Remove CtrlSum if it is not required, to avoid the mismatch.

tags.description: Name of the initiating party. InitgPty is mandatory at GrpHdr level and Nm is the principal identifier.

possible_fixes: Insert <InitgPty><Nm>{initiating party name}</Nm></InitgPty> in GrpHdr.
If only InitgPty is absent, add the full InitgPty block containing Nm.
Truncate the name to a maximum of 140 characters.

tags.description: Forwarding Agent BIC. The base ISO 20022 schema marks FwdgAgt optional, but under SWIFT CBPR+ it is MANDATORY for pain.008.

errors.description: GrpHdr/FwdgAgt is absent; it is mandatory under CBPR+ even though optional in the base schema.
possible_fixes: Insert <FwdgAgt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{forwarding_agent_BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></FwdgAgt> in GrpHdr after InitgPty.
Harvest the forwarding agent BIC from AppHdr/Fr/FIId/FinInstnId/BICFI if not otherwise known.
Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters per ISO 9362.

tags.description: Payment Information identification assigned by the initiating party to the PmtInf block.

possible_fixes: Insert <PmtInfId>{unique reference up to 35 chars}</PmtInfId> as first child of PmtInf.
Example: PMTINF-20260601-001
Truncate to a maximum of 35 characters preserving the unique prefix.

tags.description: Payment Method. For a customer direct debit initiation the only valid value is 'DD' (DirectDebit).

possible_fixes: Insert <PmtMtd>DD</PmtMtd> in PmtInf after PmtInfId.

errors.description: PmtInf/PmtMtd is not 'DD'; pain.008 only supports the DirectDebit payment method.
possible_fixes: Replace the value with 'DD'.

tags.description: Batch booking indicator. true = single batch entry; false = individual entries per transaction.

errors.description: BtchBookg is present but is not a valid boolean.
possible_fixes: Replace with 'true' or 'false' (lowercase).
Remove the element if batch booking is not being indicated.

tags.description: Number of transactions within this PmtInf block. When present, must equal the count of DrctDbtTxInf in this block.

errors.description: PmtInf/NbOfTxs does not equal the number of DrctDbtTxInf blocks within this PmtInf.
possible_fixes: Count DrctDbtTxInf within this PmtInf and set PmtInf/NbOfTxs to that value.
Remove PmtInf/NbOfTxs if not required.

tags.description: Service Level code. For SEPA direct debits the value is 'SEPA'.

errors.description: PmtTpInf/SvcLvl/Cd is not a recognised external service level code.
possible_fixes: Replace with a valid external service level code (e.g. SEPA).
Use 'SEPA' for SEPA Direct Debit schemes.

tags.description: Local Instrument code. For SEPA direct debits: CORE (consumer scheme) or B2B (business-to-business scheme).

errors.description: PmtTpInf/LclInstrm/Cd is not a valid local instrument code for the scheme.
possible_fixes: Replace with CORE (consumer) or B2B (business-to-business).
Ensure the local instrument matches the SeqTp and CdtrSchmeId used.

tags.description: Sequence Type of the direct debit. FRST=first, RCUR=recurring, FNAL=final, OOFF=one-off.

errors.description: PmtTpInf/SeqTp is not a valid sequence type code.
possible_fixes: Replace with one of FRST, RCUR, FNAL, OOFF.
Use OOFF for a one-off collection and RCUR for a recurring collection.

tags.description: Requested Collection Date. ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or a future business day; must not be in the past.

possible_fixes: Insert <ReqdColltnDt>{today or future date as YYYY-MM-DD}</ReqdColltnDt> in PmtInf.
Date only — do not include a time component, 'Z', or an offset.
Replace with today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) or the next valid business day.
Do NOT use a time component, 'Z', or an offset — date only.

tags.description: Name of the Creditor (the party collecting the direct debit). Mandatory within PmtInf/Cdtr.

possible_fixes: Insert <Cdtr><Nm>{creditor name}</Nm></Cdtr> in PmtInf.
If only Cdtr is absent, add the full Cdtr block containing Nm.
Truncate the creditor name to a maximum of 140 characters.

tags.description: Creditor account IBAN. The account to be credited with the collected funds. Must be a valid IBAN.

possible_fixes: Insert <CdtrAcct><Id><IBAN>{creditor IBAN}</IBAN></Id></CdtrAcct> in PmtInf.
Use a valid IBAN for the creditor account country.

errors.description: PmtInf/CdtrAcct/Id/IBAN fails IBAN structure or check-digit validation.
possible_fixes: Replace with a structurally valid IBAN: 2-letter country code, 2 check digits, then BBAN.
Recompute and correct the ISO 7064 mod-97 check digits.

tags.description: Creditor Agent BIC. The financial institution servicing the creditor account. Identified via FinInstnId/BICFI.

possible_fixes: Insert <CdtrAgt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{creditor agent BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></CdtrAgt> in PmtInf.
Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters per ISO 9362.

tags.description: Creditor Scheme Identification (e.g. SEPA Creditor Identifier). Carried under PrvtId/Othr/Id with SchmeNm/Prtry='SEPA'.

possible_fixes: Truncate the creditor identifier to a maximum of 35 characters.
Ensure the accompanying SchmeNm/Prtry is set to 'SEPA' for SEPA direct debits.

errors.description: CdtrSchmeId Othr is present but the SchmeNm/Prtry qualifier is missing or invalid.
possible_fixes: Insert <SchmeNm><Prtry>SEPA</Prtry></SchmeNm> within Othr for a SEPA creditor identifier.

tags.description: Charge Bearer. Specifies who bears the charges. SLEV (follow service level) is typical for SEPA direct debits.

errors.description: PmtInf/ChrgBr contains an invalid charge bearer code.
possible_fixes: Replace with one of SHAR, CRED, DEBT.
Use SHAR (SLEV disallowed by policy).

tags.description: End-to-end identification assigned by the initiating party for the collection. 'NOTPROVIDED' is allowed when unknown.

possible_fixes: Insert <EndToEndId>{end-to-end reference, max 35 chars}</EndToEndId> in PmtId.
Insert <EndToEndId>NOTPROVIDED</EndToEndId> if the value is unknown.
Truncate to a maximum of 35 characters.
Use 'NOTPROVIDED' if the original reference cannot be preserved within the limit.

tags.description: Instruction identification assigned by the initiating party for internal use. Optional, max 16 characters (CBPR+ RestrictedFINXMax16Text).

possible_fixes: Truncate to a maximum of 16 characters.
Remove InstrId if it is not required.

tags.description: Instructed amount of the collection, with mandatory Ccy attribute (ISO 4217). Amount must be greater than zero.

possible_fixes: Insert <InstdAmt Ccy="{ISO4217_currency}">{amount}</InstdAmt> in DrctDbtTxInf.
Ensure the Ccy attribute is a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 code (e.g. EUR).

errors.description: DrctDbtTxInf/InstdAmt is present but the Ccy attribute is missing or invalid.
possible_fixes: Add a Ccy attribute with a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR).
Example: <InstdAmt Ccy="EUR">100.00</InstdAmt>

tags.description: Mandate identification. Mandatory when the MndtRltdInf block is present (e.g. SEPA mandate reference).

errors.description: MndtRltdInf is present but MndtId is absent; MndtId is required when MndtRltdInf is used.
possible_fixes: Insert <MndtId>{mandate reference, max 35 chars}</MndtId> as the first child of MndtRltdInf.
Remove the MndtRltdInf block if no mandate information is available.
Truncate the mandate identifier to a maximum of 35 characters.

tags.description: Date of signature of the mandate. ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD. Mandatory when MndtRltdInf is present; must not be a future date.

errors.description: MndtRltdInf is present but DtOfSgntr is absent; DtOfSgntr is required when MndtRltdInf is used.
possible_fixes: Insert <DtOfSgntr>{mandate signature date as YYYY-MM-DD}</DtOfSgntr> in MndtRltdInf.
Date only — do not include a time component, 'Z', or an offset.

errors.description: MndtRltdInf/DtOfSgntr is in the future; a mandate cannot be signed after the message creation date.
possible_fixes: Replace with the actual mandate signature date, which must be today or earlier (YYYY-MM-DD).

tags.description: Debtor Agent BIC. The financial institution servicing the debtor account. Identified via FinInstnId/BICFI.

possible_fixes: Insert <DbtrAgt><FinInstnId><BICFI>{debtor agent BICFI}</BICFI></FinInstnId></DbtrAgt> in DrctDbtTxInf.
Replace with a valid BICFI: 8 or 11 uppercase alphanumeric characters per ISO 9362.

tags.description: Name of the Debtor (the party being debited). Mandatory within DrctDbtTxInf/Dbtr.

possible_fixes: Insert <Dbtr><Nm>{debtor name}</Nm></Dbtr> in DrctDbtTxInf.
If only Dbtr is absent, add the full Dbtr block containing Nm.
Truncate the debtor name to a maximum of 140 characters.

tags.description: Debtor account IBAN. The account to be debited. Must be a valid IBAN.

possible_fixes: Insert <DbtrAcct><Id><IBAN>{debtor IBAN}</IBAN></Id></DbtrAcct> in DrctDbtTxInf.
Use a valid IBAN for the debtor account country.

errors.description: DrctDbtTxInf/DbtrAcct/Id/IBAN fails IBAN structure or check-digit validation.
possible_fixes: Replace with a structurally valid IBAN: 2-letter country code, 2 check digits, then BBAN.
Recompute and correct the ISO 7064 mod-97 check digits.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest GrpHdr/MsgId and set BizMsgIdr to the same value (or vice versa); never invent a new value.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'pain.008.001.08' and match the Document namespace.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set MsgDefIdr to 'pain.008.001.08' consistent with the Document xmlns.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/FwdgAgt is mandatory under CBPR+ even though optional in the base schema.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Insert FwdgAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI; harvest from AppHdr/Fr if not otherwise available.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the total count of DrctDbtTxInf blocks across all PmtInf.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Count all DrctDbtTxInf elements and update GrpHdr/NbOfTxs (and PmtInf/NbOfTxs when present).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/CtrlSum (and PmtInf/CtrlSum) must equal the sum of the contained InstdAmt values when present.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Sum the InstdAmt values and update CtrlSum, or remove CtrlSum if not required.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: PmtInf/PmtMtd must be 'DD' for a customer direct debit initiation.
PmtInf/ReqdColltnDt must not be in the past relative to the message creation date.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set ReqdColltnDt to today or the next valid business day (YYYY-MM-DD).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: When MndtRltdInf is present, both MndtId and DtOfSgntr are required.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add the missing MndtId and/or DtOfSgntr, or remove the MndtRltdInf block entirely.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/CreDt and GrpHdr/CreDtTm must use a timezone offset and may not use 'Z' or milliseconds.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Normalise both to YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+00:00; replace 'Z' with +00:00 and strip milliseconds.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: When FinInstnId/BICFI is present in an agent block, Nm and PstlAdr must not be present in the same block.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove Nm and PstlAdr from any agent FinInstnId block that already carries BICFI.

schema_mapping_notes.root_element: pain.008 root is /Document/CstmrDrctDbtInitn (CustomerDirectDebitInitiation), not a pacs root.
schema_mapping_notes.biz_svc: AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.02' under CBPR+ SR2025 for pain.008.001.08.
schema_mapping_notes.fwdgagt_cbpr_mandatory: GrpHdr/FwdgAgt is optional [0..1] in the base ISO 20022 XSD but is MANDATORY under SWIFT CBPR+ for pain.008.
schema_mapping_notes.pmtmtd_fixed: PmtInf/PmtMtd is fixed to 'DD' for the customer direct debit initiation message.
schema_mapping_notes.reqd_colltn_dt: PmtInf/ReqdColltnDt (Requested Collection Date) is mandatory, date-only (ISODate), and must not be in the past.
schema_mapping_notes.instdamt_type: DrctDbtTxInf/InstdAmt uses ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount with a mandatory Ccy attribute.
schema_mapping_notes.mndt_rltd_inf: DrctDbtTx/MndtRltdInf is optional, but when present MndtId and DtOfSgntr are both required.
schema_mapping_notes.agent_identification: CdtrAgt and DbtrAgt are identified via FinInstnId/BICFI; BranchAndFinancialInstitutionIdentification with BICFI is preferred under CBPR+.
schema_mapping_notes.account_identification: CdtrAcct and DbtrAcct are identified via Id/IBAN where the account country uses IBAN.
schema_mapping_notes.single_tx_preference: CBPR+ favours single-transaction messages: NbOfTxs typically '1' with one PmtInf and one DrctDbtTxInf.
